author: RZRider
description:
The fire fades, and kingdoms fall to ash. 


WARNING: there are 2 mode 7 sections, one being a boss that will NOT work on SD2SNES, but is seemingly functional on FXPAKPro. The rest of the game is fully functional on SD2SNES, but you will more than likely need to fight the boss on emulator than transfer your save. I am sorry for the inconvenience, but I legitimately don't think there is anything I can do about it.
